_note: Scalar model parameters, low/base/high. Sources and status in docs/data_inventory.md and docs/research/*.md. Currency USD (2025-26). Energy kWh, power kW.

site.timezone: Asia/Beirut (UTC+2, UTC+3 in summer); data series are UTC

battery.cold: No charging below 0 C cell temperature; ~87% capacity at 0 C; outdoor containers rated -30 to 50 C with heating
battery.note: Use either capex_allin_per_kWh on E_b (base) or the energy + PCS split; not both.

diesel.capex_note: Base 0: existing gensets retained (sunk). 750 $/kW (low 94 - high 800 from datasheets/market) used only in the replacement sensitivity.

grid.export_allowed: base: no export. Sensitivities: (a) net metering, kWh credited at the EDL tariff within a 12-month bank, surplus beyond annual import forfeited; (b) export-price sweep

export.net_metering_annual_cap: sum export <= sum import over the year; excess forfeited
export.sources: Law 318/2023 (12-month banking, year-end compensation % to be set by ERA, not yet set); EDL net-metering scheme 2011 (circular 318-32: 12-month carry-over, unused credit goes to EDL); IEEE 1547-2018 anti-islanding (no export while the grid is off)

npv.basis: real (constant 2026 USD), unlevered, pre-tax project cash flows; financing structure unknown
npv.salvage: linear remaining life at the end of the horizon (PV 5/30 of capex, battery 5/15 of replacement)

reliability.basis: Energy-based LPSP (Borhanazad 2014 Eq. 11; Lian 2019); hard critical-load constraint (REopt, Cutler 2017); base set to 0 (Nov 2026) because the 1% allowance was taken almost entirely during the peak ski week; 1% kept in the sweep

review.note: Round 3 runs added after the external review of the draft paper (22 Nov 2026).
review.installed_cost_basis: Stress test, not an estimate: the PV (750 $/kWp) and battery (192 $/kWh all-in) benchmarks are installed costs that include inverters, battery converters and installation, but not the grid-side works of the single-line diagram (20/0.4 kV 1,000 kVA transformer, 20 kV breaker and intertie relay, micro-grid controller, MV cabling, engineering). +25% on the PV and battery capex covers them with margin.

downside.basis: All adverse inputs at once: the lowest irradiance series (PVGIS-SARAH-3 unscaled), the low end of the observed Lebanese diesel price (2023-2026), and the +25% installed cost. Run twice: base-case sizes fixed (is the chosen design still worth building?) and sizes re-optimized.

genset_outage.basis: Base-case PV and battery fixed, dispatch over the design year with the diesel limited to a share of the existing plant (the reference rating): 0.5 = one of two equal sets out for the whole year; 0 = no diesel at all (PV, battery and grid only). Load may be shed at a penalty, so the runs report how much would go unserved.
